chunks: Surely the apostles have been mocked before you; but what they had mocked rebounded on the mockers themselves.
ai.seo_question: What happened to those who mocked the prophets in the past?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (6:6) is often cited to highlight the continuity of prophetic experience, linking the mockery of earlier prophets like Noah and Abraham to the trials of the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a theological reassurance that divine retribution (haqa) is inevitable for the arrogant, reinforcing the concept of 'Adl (Divine Justice) where the fate of the mockers mirrors their scorn.
